## Issue reference

We strive to have all PRs opened based on an issue, where the problem or feature has been discussed prior to implementation.

Please reference the issue this PR closes: #_[issue number]_

## Checklist

Please make sure you've completed the relevant tasks for this PR, out of the following list:

* [ ] Code compiles correctly (`go build ./...`)
* [ ] Created / updated unit tests
* [ ] Created / updated integration tests (under `test/`)
* [ ] Linter passes (`golangci-lint run ./...`)
* [ ] Commits are signed off per the [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-signing-your-work)
* [ ] Updated documentation (README, code comments, or examples)
